hooks.name: requirement-coverage-after-task

action.prompt: A spec task just finished. Open .kiro/specs/01-parsers/tasks.md, find the task that was most recently marked complete, and read its _Requirements: line. For every acceptance criterion that line names (a whole requirement number such as 5 means all of its criteria, 5.1, 5.2 and so on), search every *.test.ts file under src/ and tests/ for the text "Req N.M" and report, in at most 12 lines: (1) the task id; (2) the criteria that are covered; (3) the criteria that are NOT covered; (4) any "Req N.M" mentioned in a test that does not exist in .kiro/specs/01-parsers/requirements.md. Do not edit any file, do not run any command and do not start another task.

hooks.description: After each spec task, checks that the criteria it claims to cover are named in a test (Req 22).
